summary: Section flush boundaries became individually addressable
description: Each snapshot block now seals into a named budget section instead of one flat parts array, so a section can carry its own demotion ladder without moving any bytes in the full render.
Rungs are thunks now, so an under-budget vault resolves none of them and pays nothing on the SessionStart hot path.

summary: Golden fixture pinned to a recorded base SHA
description: The expected render is generated in a detached worktree at the recorded BASE_SHA so it can never be circular with the change under test.
